turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
properly the very first time?
Preparing it for the first time is super quick and easy!
Ivey
Here to help you shop
1. Measure ½ cup of Instant Hummus Mix (firmly packed) into a bowl.
menu
2. Add ⅔ cup of water (hot or cold).
3. Add 1 tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil (EVOO).
4. Whisk thoroughly until smooth.
For enhanced flavor and a thicker texture, refrigerate for 15 minutes and whisk again right before serving with fresh vegetables or pita chips!
